transactions.desc: The Diamondbacks activated Soroka (shoulder) from the 15-day injured list Wednesday.
The Diamondbacks activated Gallen (elbow) from the 60-day injured list Wednesday.
The Marlins optioned Blalock to Triple-A Jacksonville on Wednesday.
The Marlins activated Fairbanks (hand) from the 15-day injured list Wednesday.
The White Sox recalled Murphy from Triple-A Charlotte on Wednesday.
The Nationals recalled Yean from Triple-A Rochester on Wednesday.
Atlanta activated Lopez (knee) from the 15-day injured list Wednesday.
Atlanta designated Hernandez for assignment Wednesday.
Suarez elected to become a free agent Wednesday, Rich Dubroff of BaltimoreBaseball.com reports.
Atlanta selected Falter's contract from Triple-A Gwinnett on Wednesday.
The Nationals optioned Kent to Triple-A Rochester after Tuesday's game against the Padres.
The Cardinals activated Winn (thumb) from the 10-day injured list Tuesday.
Rortvedt cleared waivers and accepted his outright assignment to Triple-A Oklahoma City on Tuesday, Alex Freedman of okccomets.com reports
The Pirates recalled Eisert from Triple-A Indianapolis on Tuesday.
The Cardinals optioned Prieto to Triple-A Memphis on Tuesday.
Thomas cleared waivers and accepted his outright assignment to Triple-A Oklahoma City on Tuesday, Alex Freedman of okccomets.com reports.
The Mariners reinstated Robles from the family medical emergency list Tuesday.
The Mariners designated Fairchild for assignment Tuesday.
The Mariners reinstated Milner from the family medical emergency list Tuesday.
Seattle optioned Taylor to Triple-A Tacoma on Tuesday.
The Nationals recalled Kent from Triple-A Rochester on Tuesday.
The Diamondbacks optioned Carrillo to Triple-A Reno on Tuesday.
The Diamondbacks optioned Cabrera to Triple-A Reno on Tuesday.
The Diamondbacks recalled Strowd from Triple-A Reno on Tuesday.
The Giants optioned Morgan to Triple-A Sacramento on Tuesday.
The Giants recalled Harris from Triple-A Sacramento on Tuesday.
Willits was promoted from High-A Wilmington to Double-A Harrisburg on Tuesday, Spencer Nusbaum of The Athletic reports.
The Diamondbacks reinstated Burnes (elbow) from the 60-day injured list to start Tuesday's game against the Royals.
The Rays designated Bigge for assignment Tuesday.
The Rays selected Madrigal's contract from Triple-A Durham on Tuesday, Ryan Bass of Rays.tv reports.
